game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.

win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the stone seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
